method: Web research 2026-10-15 from search-engine summaries of the cited pages (pages not opened directly).
overview: Zocdoc is a New York-headquartered (founded 2007) healthcare marketplace where patients find and book doctors; about 900 employees. Strategy-type roles are in-house business strategy and operations.

employee_support.text: Careers page lists paid parental leave, mental-health benefits, career planning and wellness programs; it also reports that 90% of employees say their manager cares about their wellbeing (company survey).
employee_support.significance: Documented basics; the 90% figure is self-reported.

flexibility.text: Built In describes a hybrid model with 2-3 office days, unlimited PTO and sabbaticals.

culture.text: Stated values include 'Patients First' and 'Learners before Masters'.

tradeoffs.text: Employee reviews are mixed: praise for PTO and balance, complaints about management turnover and strict metrics.
tradeoffs.significance: Individual reviews; ask the team directly.
